The fraud was discovered on Sunday, prompting immediate action from the microfinance company. A senior official stated that the company has insurance that covers the losses incurred due to the fraud. Services associated with the fraud were halted, and investigations are currently underway. The company has requested its bank to reverse the transactions and investigate further.
